_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.

items.text: The TMC Builder now models the WHOLE degree, not just the major: open any TMC and there's a GE Breadth panel below it — Cal-GETC (the statewide default since Fall 2025) plus the older IGETC and CSU GE Breadth — so a college can map its courses to the GE areas too and see a combined full-ADT unit total. I verified Cal-GETC against the official Standards (corrected Area 3 to 2 courses → 34 units). To verify the other two the same way, send me the official IGETC and CSU GE Breadth Forms and I'll true them up.

Your next milestone: embed CPL natively on the TMCs so a student's prior learning can satisfy a slot. I can add a per-slot chip like 'this credit may be earnable via CPL at colleges X' off our existing articulation data — kept safe ('CPL-eligible at X', never 'guaranteed credit'). Want to scope it with me before I build? It's the step that turns the TMC Builder from a transfer form into a recognition engine for prior learning.

25 course rows across the 45 TMCs carry a C-ID that ISN'T in our C-ID reference (most are the 2026 TMCs — Music Industry Studies is 10/10). Per your note that's a useful 'maybe C-ID needs updating (or our reference is stale)' signal. Say the word and I'll turn it into a small exportable report you could send to the C-ID team.

✨ Suggested merges (data lane, still live): groups by the obvious keyword (Algebra, the languages, ESL, Ballet) — divider words AND abbreviations fold. Confirm the obvious families; UNCHECK or Skip a genuine progression (units are the tell). Popup tools: '➕ Add more courses by keyword', the 🏷 'match strength' slider, title-cleanup on a different target, and a 'Completion note' box.

395 college course titles carry encoding garbage at the source. The dashboard shows them repaired with a '⚠ fix in COCI' chip; the campaign list is kb/coci_title_corrections.json — take it to the colleges when ready.
MilStudents dataset: ping me when it's live in the Custom Reports module — that wires the true JSTs-uploaded universe into the Veteran card (aggregates only, no student IDs).

Finish the GE half: true up IGETC + CSU GE Breadth against their official forms the same way Cal-GETC was verified (#457). Pin each pattern's total units in tests/tmc_ge_breadth.test.js as the tripwire (a wrong select-count silently breaks the total). Forms arrive via upload — the CCCCO Breadth Form PDFs bot-block the agent env.

Scope the CPL-native TMC wiring with Sam BEFORE building: for each TMC C-ID slot, surface where a CPL articulation already maps to that C-ID/credential (kb/coci_articulations.json + the CCR adoption-leverage layer + EACR identity) → a per-slot 'CPL-eligible at colleges X' chip. Safe framing only — 'eligible at X', never 'guaranteed credit.'

TMC Builder polish: (1) a 'N of your courses carry a C-ID in COCI' coverage hint + a title-similarity 'suggested (verify)' secondary fill for sparse-coverage colleges (distinct from C-ID auto-fill); (2) faculty-verify the 45 draft TMCs (science 'OR' sequences roughest); (3) optional statewide adoption view off tmc_submissions (no PII). Plus a focused §7d rewrite to drop the stale dropdown/Coming-soon prose.

Data lane (paused): lower the member-join title Jaccard 0.5 → ~0.4 so more raw college courses attach per identity. kb/README mandates MEASURING member-row flips FIRST — prototype the title-filtered raw-list join, count attach/detach at 0.4 vs 0.5, sample the 0.3–0.5 band, present before committing. Its own measured PR + dispatch.

On Sam's go: DRY-RUN title-lane pass 2 — `python3 kb/_auto_merge_worklist.py --pass2-title` (receipt kb/automerge_out/<date>-titlelane/). Present counts; apply only on sign-off, then re-key Supabase via the supabase-rekey workflow + dispatch.
